meta.title: Ticketing Outcome: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in as a Requester / End User on a tenant below Growth and use Ticketing Outcome to verify the capability is refused or absent.
Repeat the Ticketing Outcome workflow on a Growth tenant and verify it is available and generates an intake ID.
Inspect or change the tenant subscription plan and compare outcomes across the two plans.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Requester / End User on a tenant below Growth and use Ticketing Outcome to verify the capability is refused or absent.; Repeat the Ticketing Outcome workflow on a Growth tenant and verify it is available and generates an intake ID.; Inspect or change the tenant subscription plan and compare outcomes across the two plans.

args.need: sign in as the same Requester / End User on a tenant below Growth and a Growth tenant, use Ticketing Outcome to generate a standard-approval intake ID on each, and verify that the lower-plan tenant refuses or omits the capability while Growth allows it

steps.note: The requester workflow, Ticketing Outcome capability, intake ID generation, and plan comparison are not represented by catalog steps.
Provides a final assertion after the tester interaction without claiming that the Ticketing Outcome behavior was verified.
